questions.question_text: Nine samples each have a mass of $0.62$ g. Estimate their total mass by rounding each factor to 1 significant figure.

options.why: Rounded $0.62$ to the nearest whole number, $1$, instead of to 1 significant figure, giving $1\times9=9$ g.
Used $6$ instead of $0.6$ for the rounded sample mass, giving $6\times9=54$ g.
Rounded the sample mass correctly but omitted multiplication by the $9$ samples.

questions.solution_text:
$0.62\approx0.6$ and $9\approx9$.
$0.6\times9=5.4$.
The total mass is about $5.4$ g.
